interface.name: unity_preview_manager_v1

description.summary: window previews drawn by the compositor

interface.description: Creates previews of windows inside client surfaces.

request.name: get_mirror

description.summary: create a preview of a window

request.description: If the window does not exist or is not mapped, the compositor sends closed at once. The preview shows while the surface is a mapped wayfire view, also when the surface gets its role later or is mapped again.

arg.name: surface
arg.summary: the surface that shows the preview

arg.name: view_id
arg.summary: wayfire view id of the window

interface.name: unity_preview_mirror_v1

description.summary: a window preview inside a surface

interface.description: set_rect, set_alpha and set_order are double-buffered. They apply on the next commit of the host surface. The preview is drawn above the surface content and clipped to the surface. The preview is not drawn while its rectangle is empty or its alpha is 0.

request.name: set_rect
request.description: Surface-local coordinates. The initial rectangle is empty. A negative width or height is an invalid_rect error.

request.name: set_alpha
request.description: From 0 to 1. The initial alpha is 1. Another value is an invalid_alpha error.

request.name: set_order

description.summary: set the stacking order of the preview

request.description: A preview with a higher order is drawn above the previews of the same surface with a lower order. Previews with the same order keep their relative position, and a new preview starts above them. The initial order is 0.

event.name: source_size

description.summary: size of the window, shadow included

event.description: Sent after get_mirror and when the size changes.

event.name: closed
event.description: The compositor ignores all later requests except destroy.
